name: Microsoft 365
description: Access SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Teams directly in Claude. Search and analyze documents across sites and libraries, review email threads and communications, and extract insights from calendar and chat data. Make Microsoft 365 a native part of your Claude workflows while respecting all existing permissions and security controls. Built for Microsoft 365 at work — your company's SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, and Teams. Requires a work or school account (you@yourcompany.com). Personal accounts like outlook.com, hotmail.com, or live.com aren't supported.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Microsoft 365 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Microsoft 365 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://microsoft365.mcp.claude.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Microsoft 365 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Microsoft 365 provides these MCP tools: sharepoint_search, sharepoint_folder_search, outlook_email_search, outlook_calendar_search, find_meeting_availability, chat_message_search, and read_resource.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Microsoft 365?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Microsoft 365 in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Microsoft 365 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Microsoft 365 is developed by Anthropic. It is listed as anthropic on the Claude connector directory.
